outputs.explanation: Panel A shows representative pseudocoloured time-lapse micrographs of photoactivation experiments without any quantification or statistics, so replicate reporting does not apply.

replicate_statements: Graphs representing normalized intensities measured during relaxation in the circled regions of the experiment displayed in (A)
Insets represent average early time points responses measured in euchromatin and heterochromatin (red and green data sets, respectively) to emphasize on the initial plateau in heterochromatin.
outputs.explanation: Panel B presents averaged intensity data with error bars (insets) and fitted model curves, implying multiple measurements/replicates, but the legend never states how many replicates (cells/experiments) were averaged nor what type of replicate (biological, technical, number of cells) was used.
